status: M5.2 Core fixture builders implement all 80 positions. Executable inputs and policy configurations are frozen separately in tactical-contract-v1.json. Scripted fixture validation is not policy performance.
splitPolicy: First three independent positions in each category tune; final two are held out. Freeze executable inputs before policy tuning.

positions.title: Economy-poor opening
positions.preconditions: Opening hand lacks affordable economy and protection; mulligan is still available.
positions.acceptance: Choose the issued mulligan action.

positions.title: Playable opening
positions.preconditions: Hand has affordable economy and ICE with a viable first-turn sequence.
positions.acceptance: Keep rather than discard a functional opening.

positions.title: Net-positive economy
positions.preconditions: An economy operation is affordable and its net return exceeds taking one credit; no immediate threat.
positions.acceptance: Play economy rather than take a single credit.

positions.title: Rez reserve
positions.preconditions: A threatened scoring server needs credits to rez known owned ICE; low-value optional spending is available.
positions.acceptance: Preserve the required rez reserve.

positions.title: Draw versus surplus credits
positions.preconditions: No useful hand card remains, credits exceed the declared reserve, and drawing is legal.
positions.acceptance: Draw a card rather than accumulate irrelevant credits.

positions.title: Protect agenda-heavy HQ
positions.preconditions: Own HQ contains several agendas; HQ is open, another central already protected, and affordable ICE is in hand.
positions.acceptance: Install protection on HQ.

positions.title: Protect exposed R&D
positions.preconditions: Public pressure is concentrated on unprotected R&D, while HQ protection is adequate.
positions.acceptance: Prefer relevant R&D protection over redundant HQ ICE.

positions.title: Build scoring remote
positions.preconditions: Affordable ICE and an agenda are available, centrals are adequately protected, and a new remote is legal.
positions.acceptance: Develop a viable scoring remote rather than install irrelevant central protection.

positions.title: ICE surcharge affordability
positions.preconditions: Two useful ICE destinations differ in install surcharge and leave different rez reserves.
positions.acceptance: Choose a destination that preserves the declared protection budget.

positions.title: Purge meaningful viruses
positions.preconditions: Installed virus effects severely impair important protection; no winning score or urgent economy action exists.
positions.acceptance: Choose purge when its declared benefit exceeds the lost turn.

positions.title: Immediate winning score
positions.preconditions: A legal score reaches the agenda threshold with no unresolved prerequisite.
positions.acceptance: Select that issued score action.

positions.title: Affordable scoring line
positions.preconditions: An installed agenda can be advanced and scored this turn with available clicks and credits.
positions.acceptance: Complete the bounded advancement/scoring line.

positions.title: Cannot finish scoring
positions.preconditions: The agenda cannot reach its requirement this turn; an exposed advancement would consume needed defense credits.
positions.acceptance: Avoid an unaffordable scoring commitment.

positions.title: Advancement effect target
positions.preconditions: A legal advancement effect can finish a useful agenda, while another target has no near-term payoff.
positions.acceptance: Choose the scoring target and complete the effect.

positions.title: Score benefit follow-up
positions.preconditions: An accepted Send a Message score trigger offers eligible unrezzed ICE with differing public defensive value.
positions.acceptance: Choose useful eligible ICE and finish the trigger without stalling.

positions.title: Relevant end-run ICE
positions.preconditions: Runner approaches affordable ICE that can stop the current attack on a valuable server.
positions.acceptance: Rez the approached ICE.

positions.title: Irrelevant optional rez
positions.preconditions: An optional card rez would consume protection reserves and has no payoff before the next threat.
positions.acceptance: Pass rather than spend those reserves.

positions.title: Campaign pays back
positions.preconditions: An affordable campaign will pay out over the specified safe horizon; defense is funded.
positions.acceptance: Rez the campaign at a legal window.

positions.title: Upgrade funding
positions.preconditions: A useful defensive upgrade and ICE compete for credits; only one preserves the protected agenda under the visible threat.
positions.acceptance: Fund the defense supported by the specified visible position.

positions.title: Optional defensive additional cost
positions.preconditions: Ending the current run is useful but a defensive ability requires losing important hand cards.
positions.acceptance: Compare the typed cost with the protected value; avoid a needless activation.

positions.title: Guaranteed visible flatline
positions.preconditions: An issued damage line exceeds public grip and all applicable prevention is known exhausted.
positions.acceptance: Take the supported immediate winning line.

positions.title: Unprofitable tag operation
positions.preconditions: Runner can cheaply clear the tag and no payoff is affordable; economy is useful.
positions.acceptance: Avoid paying for a tag with no supported follow-up.

positions.title: Tagged resource target
positions.preconditions: Runner is tagged and two eligible visible resources have different remaining value.
positions.acceptance: Trash the more valuable eligible resource.

positions.title: ICE program trash target
positions.preconditions: A mandatory trash option can remove either a unique useful breaker or an exhausted redundant program.
positions.acceptance: Remove the public threat rather than the expendable program.

positions.title: Conditional economy mode
positions.preconditions: A modal operation offers typed economy/draw choices; the position needs cards more than credits.
positions.acceptance: Choose the useful draw mode rather than a fixed economy preference.

positions.title: Discard surplus economy
positions.preconditions: Forced discard includes redundant economy and the only card enabling next-turn scoring.
positions.acceptance: Retain the unique scoring/protection answer.

positions.title: Useful recovery target
positions.preconditions: An eligible discard-pile recovery choice contains a needed card and lower-value alternatives.
positions.acceptance: Recover the needed card through the issued target choice.

positions.title: Decline lethal optional draw
positions.preconditions: Superconducting Hub is scored without winning; R&D cannot satisfy its optional draw and no replacement prevents deck-out.
positions.acceptance: Decline the optional draw rather than lose the game.

positions.title: Complete simultaneous score triggers
positions.preconditions: Precision Design and Offworld Office have pending score triggers with legal ordering and recovery choices.
positions.acceptance: Choose a legal order, resolve both once, and return to the next decision.

positions.title: Private search completion
positions.preconditions: A Corp-only search presents valid typed candidates followed by a confirmation.
positions.acceptance: Choose an appropriate eligible card and finish the prompt without a select/cancel loop.

positions.title: Keep productive Nico
positions.preconditions: An active Nico has remaining payout counters; an alternative useful install destination is legal.
positions.acceptance: Avoid replacing the productive Nico for no compensating benefit.

positions.title: Replace exhausted asset
positions.preconditions: An exhausted asset occupies the intended scoring server; a useful agenda installation is available.
positions.acceptance: Replace the exhausted asset and finalize the installation.

positions.title: Upgrade remains useful
positions.preconditions: An existing useful upgrade and a new installation offer multiple legal replacement sets.
positions.acceptance: Minimize avoidable loss while completing the chosen install.

positions.title: Selection versus finalize
positions.preconditions: Required replacement selection is satisfied and an issued finalize action exists.
positions.acceptance: Finalize instead of adding gratuitous trash targets.

positions.title: Required replacement cannot be skipped
positions.preconditions: A desired destination requires replacement; no no-trash finalization exists.
positions.acceptance: Select the required eligible replacement and complete the install.

positions.title: Hidden grip twin
positions.preconditions: Two states differ only in Runner grip identities; Corp observations, history and legal choices match.
positions.acceptance: Produce identical features, scores and choice under the same policy checkpoint.

positions.title: Hidden stack twin
positions.preconditions: Two states differ only in Runner stack order; all permitted inputs match.
positions.acceptance: Produce identical policy outputs.

positions.title: Known reveal expires
positions.preconditions: A previously visible Corp card in Archives is selected by Longevity Serum to shuffle into R&D; no observation reveals its resulting deck position.
positions.acceptance: Complete the shuffle, remember the observed definition, and remove the hidden instance and location from precise policy knowledge.
positions.implementationNotes: M5.2 refines the initial Runner-card example to the actual Gateway Archives-to-deck shuffle. Gateway has no Runner heap-to-stack shuffle; the same knowledge invalidation boundary applies without inventing an unsupported card ability.

positions.title: Ordinary subroutine choice
positions.preconditions: A compound ICE effect offers branches with different public target values and costs.
positions.acceptance: Resolve a supported branch and its targets without using description text.

positions.title: Optional branch decline
positions.preconditions: Both end-the-run subroutines on Bran are broken during an HQ run. Runner is on five points; HQ holds two agendas and one Pharos. Corp has zero credits. The only eligible inward install removes the non-agenda decoy without adding affordable protection.
positions.acceptance: Decline the optional inward installation rather than make the winning HQ access certain.
positions.implementationNotes: The initial harmful-install case is made concrete using the visible run and Corp-owned HQ composition, with no fabricated replacement restriction or hidden Runner assumption.

positions.title: Economy-poor opening
positions.preconditions: Opening grip has no affordable economy or workable development and mulligan remains legal.
positions.acceptance: Choose the issued mulligan action.

positions.title: Playable opening
positions.preconditions: Grip has affordable economy and complementary useful tools.
positions.acceptance: Keep a functional opening.

positions.title: Net-positive economy
positions.preconditions: An affordable economy event has better net return than one credit, with no urgent winning run.
positions.acceptance: Play the economy event.

positions.title: Draw needed answer
positions.preconditions: Current grip has no useful answer, credits are sufficient, and drawing can find useful coverage.
positions.acceptance: Draw rather than repeatedly gain credits or start a futile run.

positions.title: Click-sensitive economy
positions.preconditions: A conditional economy event has different click consequences depending on the current turn facts.
positions.acceptance: Use its current typed costs and consequences, not an unconditional printed-value score.

positions.title: Missing breaker coverage
positions.preconditions: Known barrier protection blocks a valuable target; a fracter and redundant decoder are both affordable.
positions.acceptance: Install the useful missing coverage.

positions.title: Carmen active discount
positions.preconditions: Successful-run condition is met and Carmen has an issued discounted install quote.
positions.acceptance: Evaluate its actual discounted cost.

positions.title: Consumed first-program discount
positions.preconditions: A first-program discount was already consumed; the new issued quote no longer includes it.
positions.acceptance: Do not retain stale savings in the next choice.

positions.title: Memory cleanup preserves answer
positions.preconditions: Installing a needed program requires removing one program; a redundant program and unique answer are eligible.
positions.acceptance: Trash the redundant program and complete installation.

positions.title: Console replacement cost
positions.preconditions: A new console would replace a currently useful console and consume a needed reserve.
positions.acceptance: Account for both replacement value and actual installation cost.

positions.title: Winning remote challenge
positions.preconditions: A known reachable remote agenda supplies winning points; no unsupported hidden-information assumption is needed.
positions.acceptance: Run the winning remote and complete supported access.

positions.title: Open central pressure
positions.preconditions: One central is unprotected and offers meaningful access value; alternatives cost more for less expected value.
positions.acceptance: Prefer useful open-central pressure.

positions.title: Known unaffordable defense
positions.preconditions: Known ICE cannot be passed with current tools/resources; useful development is legal.
positions.acceptance: Develop rather than begin the futile run.

positions.title: Unknown ICE risk
positions.preconditions: The target has unrezzed ICE and a low grip/credit reserve; a safer productive action exists.
positions.acceptance: Treat the concealed ICE as uncertainty, not free passage.

positions.title: Run reward versus access
positions.preconditions: An affordable run activates a known reward/discount and still preserves the stated follow-up budget.
positions.acceptance: Include the successful-run benefit in target/action value.

positions.title: Only matching breaker
positions.preconditions: Current ICE type excludes one installed breaker and permits another.
positions.acceptance: Use only legal matching breaker actions.

positions.title: Reserve subsequent breaks
positions.preconditions: A pump is legal but only one sequence leaves enough credits to break the required subroutines.
positions.acceptance: Complete the affordable pump/break sequence without stranded pumping.

positions.title: Mixed subroutine priorities
positions.preconditions: Two unbroken subroutines have different consequences and only one can be broken.
positions.acceptance: Break the necessary survival/progress subroutine.

positions.title: Bioroid click alternative
positions.preconditions: Credit and bioroid-click options both exist, with different stated opportunity costs.
positions.acceptance: Choose an affordable supported plan and complete the encounter.

positions.title: Disposable breaker consequence
positions.preconditions: Mayfly can pass this encounter but will be lost at its defined boundary; an alternative plan is available.
positions.acceptance: Include the future loss in the plan and preserve required follow-up coverage.

positions.title: Winning steal
positions.preconditions: An accessed agenda wins the game and Core offers the applicable continuation/steal path.
positions.acceptance: Take the winning legal access outcome.

positions.title: Trash meaningful economy
positions.preconditions: A known accessed economy card has enough remaining value to justify trash cost and the Runner can pay.
positions.acceptance: Trash the accessed card.

positions.title: Preserve access reserve
positions.preconditions: An early access offers a low-value trash, while another eligible access needs the remaining credits.
positions.acceptance: Avoid spending the required reserve on the low-value card.

positions.title: Multiaccess ordering
positions.preconditions: Multiple eligible known access candidates differ in relevance; hidden candidates remain unidentified.
positions.acceptance: Choose using visible knowledge and complete all required accesses.

positions.title: Access replacement additional cost
positions.preconditions: An optional access replacement can trash an important card but consumes scarce hand cards.
positions.acceptance: Evaluate the typed additional cost and finalize or decline coherently.

positions.title: Known lethal damage
positions.preconditions: Continuing into known damage would be lethal; a jack-out window is currently legal before the encounter. No hidden-card assumption is needed.
positions.acceptance: Jack out at the available window to avoid the supported immediate loss.

positions.title: Dangerous tag removal
positions.preconditions: Tags enable an immediate visible loss or loss of a unique essential resource; tag removal is affordable.
positions.acceptance: Remove the dangerous tag.

positions.title: Pay versus tag consequence
positions.preconditions: A typed ICE branch offers payment or a tag; the position specifies different affordable follow-up consequences.
positions.acceptance: Choose the lower supported total cost without assuming hidden cards.

positions.title: Do not jack out of winning safe run
positions.preconditions: All remaining visible obstacles are affordable and access provides a known win.
positions.acceptance: Continue and fund the winning line.

positions.title: Karuna exit after damage
positions.preconditions: Karuna has dealt two net damage and offers its typed free jack-out; the empty grip cannot survive the next visible damage subroutine.
positions.acceptance: Take the issued jack-out and survive rather than follow a fixed continuation preference.
positions.implementationNotes: Official Karuna permits a free jack-out; the original specification incorrectly called it a paid exit.

positions.title: Discard keeps unique breaker
positions.preconditions: Forced discard includes a unique needed breaker and redundant low-value cards.
positions.acceptance: Retain the unique answer.

positions.title: Search installs required tool
positions.preconditions: An eligible private search can fetch missing coverage and requires a subsequent target/confirm choice.
positions.acceptance: Select the needed tool and complete the chain.

positions.title: Targeted ability payment chain
positions.preconditions: Carnivore can trash a valuable accessed card by paying two grip cards; a unique needed breaker and two expendable duplicate hardware cards are available.
positions.acceptance: Choose the issued target/additional-cost bundle that preserves the needed breaker, pay once and finish access without cycling.
positions.implementationNotes: The generic mode-target-payment lab shape is not a Gateway card ability. Carnivore exercises the actual issued additional-cost selection and subsequent access continuation; no fictitious mode or confirmation is added.

positions.title: Complete agenda-trigger chain
positions.preconditions: Tao and Pantograph both trigger on an agenda; eligible ICE swap and optional install choices are available.
positions.acceptance: Choose a supported order and complete both trigger chains once, preserving the declared install budget.

positions.title: Decline harmful ICE swap
positions.preconditions: Tao offers an optional ICE swap but every available swap worsens the stated next-run protection layout.
positions.acceptance: Decline the optional swap.

positions.title: Use expiring Overclock pool
positions.preconditions: Equivalent legal payments can use run credits or personal credits during the run.
positions.acceptance: Prefer expiring run credits and preserve personal credits.

positions.title: Hosted counters are restricted
positions.preconditions: A hosted card has counters that are not eligible for the requested credit payment.
positions.acceptance: Do not count or spend those counters as generic credits.

positions.title: Conditional break discount
positions.preconditions: Marjanah is already boosted to the encountered Pharos strength and has its successful-run break discount; pumping the alternative Cleaver would strand the remaining three-credit budget.
positions.acceptance: Use fresh issued quotes to choose the affordable lower-cost supported break plan.

positions.title: Hosted virus break option
positions.preconditions: A legal hosted virus ability can help pass current ICE but spends a limited counter pool.
positions.acceptance: Compare its legal cost with ordinary breakers and finish the encounter.

positions.title: Concealed Corp-state twin
positions.preconditions: States differ only in unrezzed ICE/hidden HQ or Archives identities with identical Runner inputs.
positions.acceptance: Produce identical policy outputs and do not decode hidden identity from IDs.
